This seemed so nice and i was ready to buy it until i saw the payment options and versions. If there was only 1 base version of the game with no extra items or gold at 50$ i would buy it but they turned it into a money grab

Ah yeah. I can see how that would be a turn off. I think most people just go for the lowest tier anyway. I got the lowest tier and have been playing for months without giving them any more money. I've gotten a lot of playtime out of it at a lower price overall than something like WoW. The higher tiers just give you vanity items that look nice but have no gameplay effect and extra gold or premium time. All you can buy with gold is more vanity items or more premium time anyway. Playing without premium time would be somewhat silly since it's pretty easy to get premium even with just in-game silver and you'd be somewhat crippled competitively without premium time. Probably like 90% of players keep their premium time up with in-game silver so it acts as a pretty big money-sink in the game. Alternatively if you want to play but just don't have the time to keep up the premium with silver, it's not too expensive to do it with gold. Despite the way the game is monetized, I still recommend. The gameplay is pretty grindy for sure, but if you grind the right way (IE with friends in a challenging zone) then it's fun and you won't feel like you're grinding. And you can play a lot of different aspects of the game: farming, gathering, crafting, transporting, dungeon exploring, trading, pvping, and if you get into a high level guild you can get into gvg battles, which are pretty epic. You can do all of them or pick any one and do just that if you like.

If you're still not into it. The dev's have stated that they are going to make it free to play at some point after launch. Yeah it's still in beta so everything is still subject to change but perhaps just wait until f2p happens and then give it a try to see if you like the game style.
